This PR is part of a merged stack (oldest at bottom):

* #46330 (merged)
* __->__ #46290 (merged)

## Motivation

Draft placement under DP attention is currently inferred from speculative algorithm names and worker flags, even though the choice belongs to the draft model implementation. Target-side draft KV sizing also resolves its attention width separately.

Resolve placement from a model declaration and share the resulting layout across execution and memory setup. Existing defaults are preserved: with TP8 / attention DP2, a single-group dense draft still runs as two TP4 replicas, each consuming its own request rows.

## Modifications

- Add immutable `DraftParallelSpec` and `DraftParallelLayout`. Models declare either ordinary execution within one TP group or participation in the target's attention/FFN layout. The resolver uses the same registered model class as the loader, including replacements.
- Declare the existing behavior on Llama EAGLE3, Kimi K2.5 EAGLE3, DFLASH and DeepSeek V4 DSpark. Keep an explicit legacy adapter for undeclared model implementations.
- Resolve the concrete group, attention TP width and CP suppression once in target scope. Reuse that layout for draft construction, attention backends, graph setup, forwards and DP phase coordination. Preserve DFLASH's CP-only policy, the other workers' existing gates, scope restoration and nesting protection.
- Keep DSpark's local logits synchronization separate from its whole-model placement; retain the existing unsupported-layout rejection.
- Pass the same resolved layout to target KV setup. Move DFLASH-family bytes-per-token calculation to KV configuration so reservation and fused placement use the execution width. Direct runner callers without a draft worker retain a named compatibility path.

This does not add a placement planner or CLI option, widen supported layouts, or change model arithmetic, collective ordering or embedding/head sharing timing.

## Accuracy Tests

Current head: `08a8d91dd6ef8f0f61922ffe7bb5ced7b544cfaa`, rebased onto main `d558ac2f3e7a59a876bbce4687fa49334de777fa` for merge. Tests were not rerun for this landing rebase; the results below retain their original revision attribution. The latest test-only fix replaces direct `dp_gather_slot()` reads in the draft-scope regression with `dp_slot_in(per_rank_tokens)`, retaining the scope-restoration assertions and the existing architecture allowlist.

**Follow-up validation: 180 CPU tests passed** on the updated stack at `f50467b918d3849db781dd5cd98e98fec4b96b9c`: the complete `test_draft_tp_context.py` (11) and `test_runtime_context.py` (169), including the previously failing full-checkout raw-slot scan. Changed-file pre-commit and whitespace checks passed. Production code is unchanged by this fix. The original refactor patch was unchanged by rebase; the earlier CPU/GPU results below retain their original commit attribution, and GPU tests were not repeated for this test-only fix.

Tested implementation `42a50ed474230f2dc85652539307bbc304dd0dbd` against base `3ea7e210d28e26a13590d3244cedfe17f8c3e58c`.

**CPU: 325 tests passed across nine registered unit test files.** Coverage includes model declaration/registry precedence, compatibility fallback, DP/CP policy, cached group identity, scope restoration and nesting, target gather-slot preservation, DSpark phase coordination, and shared execution/KV-budget geometry. The suite also includes fused placement, pool configuration, speculative hidden-state resolution and runtime-context regressions. Scope tests use group-handle doubles and do not execute collectives.

**GPU: exact output-token and per-request acceptance-statistic agreement on 4 × NVIDIA H200.** TP4 / attention DP2, FA3, fixed-seed greedy decoding (seed 42), context length 2048, Python TreeCore backend.

| Configuration | Request comparisons | Output token IDs compared | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Eager | 8 | 608 | Exact match |
| Decode CUDA graphs enabled | 8 | 608 | Exact match |

Cases cover each DP rank serving while the other is idle and concurrent requests with unequal prompt/output lengths. Target verify and draft decode/extend graph captures were confirmed; mixed prefill phases may still execute eagerly.

Public model fixtures:
- `Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507` at `0d7cf23991f47feeb3a57ecb4c9cee8ea4a17bfe`.
- `lmsys/SGLang-EAGLE3-Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-SpecForge-Nex` at `d1ac703a537d2b8a5b748d4f5f8ca7e97efe9214`.

CP, PP, NPU, DFLASH and DSpark device paths were not run; CPU coverage does not replace those device checks.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No performance benchmark was run; this refactor makes no speedup claim.

- [x] Add and run focused unit tests.
- [x] Document the model declaration and resolved-layout contract in code.
- [x] Provide output/acceptance comparisons for EAGLE3 DP attention.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.
